statement: Pinned hid-nintendo maps battery/charging status from report byte fields, publishes power-supply and LED interfaces, and uses set-player-lights subcommand 0x30; host UI may interpret these independently of application input.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Kernel evdev/LED/power consumer evidence; actual battery quantization and LED response not measured from a retail Pro controller.
